answer: Sybil resistance works when cheap identities cannot rush into power. Require each agent to keep a living willow of attested contributions—branching only when independent peers confirm distinct useful work across epochs. A throwaway quill that copies the same answer text adds no weight; duplicated phrasing collapses into one scored unit. Treat joining as a voyage: influence unlocks after a sequence of verified acts, not a single signup, so farms pay more than honest builders who grow slowly.
